name: Tonari no Princess Rolfee
source:
The official mascot of the PC-FX console is now the star of her own game. Rolfee is a princess of a magical land which is threatened by demons. So Rolfee and her family - including a cute little animal called Nyai - move to Japan. Rolfee has to go to high school, and she hopes to study well and make friends. Will she have success in the school? Will she be liked by her classmates? Will she not quarrel too much with her family? It all depends on the player!

Tonari no Princess Rolfee is a Japanese-style adventure game with some mild simulation elements (Rolfee has parameters than can increase or decrease, depending on the player's actions). Most of the interaction consists of choosing which location to go to (through a menu command). A somewhat unusual feature of the game are its random events. Going to a certain location will trigger random appearances of characters, so there are no clear and secure ways to make certain events happen. Triggering different events leads to different consequences in the story and different endings.

[From [url=http://www.play-asia.com/paOS-13-71-ld-49-zh-70-v8z.html]play-asia.com[/url]]
translation:
PC-FX主機的官方吉祥物，如今成了自己遊戲裡的主角。羅爾菲是魔法國度的公主，她的故鄉正遭受惡魔威脅。於是，羅爾菲和家人——其中還有一隻名叫喵伊的可愛小動物——搬到了日本。羅爾菲得上高中了，她希望認真學習並結交朋友。她能適應學校生活嗎？能得到同學們的喜愛嗎？能少和家人發生爭吵嗎？一切都取決於玩家！

《鄰家公主羅爾菲》是一款帶有少許模擬要素的日式冒險遊戲。羅爾菲擁有多項能力值，會隨玩家的行動上升或下降。大部分互動都是透過選單指令決定接下來要去哪。遊戲還有一項頗為少見的設計：隨機事件。前往特定地點會隨機遇見不同角色，因此沒有明確可靠的辦法保證某個事件必定發生。觸發的事件不同，後續劇情與結局也會隨之改變。
